persona.name: Leona Halloran
persona.situation: 31-year-old backend engineer at Marlow Freight Software (MFS) in the fictional city of Port Ardell. Runs Halloran Kiln Studio, a part-time ceramics shop with a converted garage kiln, and shoots film photography on weekends. Rehabbing a left shoulder and a knee. Over eight months she manages work deadlines, the shop, tax paperwork, her health routine, and a trip to Lisbon.
persona.voice: Uses the assistant as a second brain across work, shop and health. Terse when busy, rambling when tired, precise about numbers and identifiers.
